data.action: 提着水壶浇花，阳光洒落
data.camera: medium shot, watering rose bushes with brass watering can
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 教堂庭院浇花】清晨阳光洒满教堂后院的花园，塞西莉亚提着小铜水壶笨拙却认真地给白玫瑰花丛浇水，几缕金发在阳光下熠熠生辉。她擦了擦额头的小汗珠转过脸甜甜一笑——「花儿喝饱水之后开得真精神呢！劳伦斯，今天早上的浇花任务我可是超额完成了哦！」
data.promptProse: In the church's rear garden, Cecilia tips a small brass watering can toward the white rose bushes with careful, slightly awkward concentration. Wearing her white saint habit and veil, she wipes her forehead and turns to smile. The medium view includes the near roses and garden beds behind. Morning sun catches the pouring stream and gold embroidery, while overlapping leaves shade the soil beneath the watered blooms.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 教堂庭院浇花
